concepts.name: Socket Connect vs Read Timeouts
concepts.explanation: Connect timeout governs establishing TCP connection; read timeout limits wait time between subsequent chunks.
concepts.why_it_matters: When streaming large payloads, read timeouts reset for every chunk read, whereas connect timeout only applies at connection establishment.

concepts.name: Chunked HTTP Streaming (iter_content)
concepts.explanation: Downloading large HTTP bodies in chunks instead of loading the entire payload into RAM at once.
concepts.why_it_matters: Essential for high-throughput and memory-constrained applications.

patch_suggestion.summary: Clarify connect vs read timeouts when streaming response chunks.
patch_suggestion.code_snippet:
When streaming with ``stream=True``, the ``timeout`` parameter applies differently:

.. code-block:: python

    # Connect timeout applies to initial TCP handshake (3.05s);
    # Read timeout applies to each individual chunk iteration (27s):
    with requests.get('https://httpbin.org/stream/20', stream=True, timeout=(3.05, 27)) as r:
        for chunk in r.iter_content(chunk_size=1024):
            process_chunk(chunk)
assumptions: Assumes standard Requests API with httpbin.org sample endpoint.
patch_suggestion.expected_effect: Users understand how to prevent hanging sockets during chunked downloads.
potential_risks: Check that RST compiles without syntax or indentation errors.
